description: A layered sequencer: a pitch row of eight stages, a semitone row of seven and an octave row of four run at their own clock ratios, and their outputs are added into one note

params.text: Sets that stage's pitch, -2V to 2V, which the semitone and octave rows are added to
Sets that step's transposition in semitones, -12 to 12
Sets that step's transposition in octaves, -3 to 3
Switches that pitch stage in or out of the sequence; the last one left in its group of four cannot be switched out
Switches that semitone step in or out of the sequence
Switches that octave step in or out of the sequence
Adds one to that row's beat count on each press, which is how many times the row advances per cycle
Takes one off that row's beat count on each press, down to none, at which the row stops advancing
Adds one to that row's step count on each press, which is how many clock beats the row's cycle lasts
Takes one off that row's step count on each press, down to none, at which the row is switched off
Steps that position of the gate pattern through gate, inverted gate and silence on each press
Sets how many steps of the gate pattern are used, 1 to 24
Sets how the pitch row and the gate pattern advance together: Stage moves the pattern once per stage, Step moves it on every beat and samples the note with it, and Hybrid falls between them
Sets which way the semitone row runs: Fwd forward, Rev backward, and Ping-Pong turning round at each end
Sets which half of the pitch row the octave transposition is applied to: Left, Right, or Both
Returns every row and the gate pattern to their first positions on each press
Sets whether the sequence runs: Off holds every row where it is, On runs it round and round, and One-Shot stops it after one pass
Jumps to that layer on each press and brings its knobs, switches and ratios back onto the panel
Steps to the next layer on each press, wrapping round after four
Added to the note the sequencer puts out, -2V to 2V

inputs.text: Each rise advances every row by one beat; the row ratios are counted against it, so the module has no tempo of its own
A rise returns every row and the gate pattern to their first positions
Added to the note the sequencer puts out, on top of the offset knob
A rise steps to the next layer; with the menu set to select by CV it picks the layer directly at one volt per layer instead
Changes the gate pattern length, added to the pattern knob, the total rounded up and clamped to 1 to 24

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the gate pattern is on a gate step and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the gate pattern is not on a gate step
The note the sequencer puts out: the current pitch stage plus the current semitone step, the current octave step and the two offsets, snapped to whole semitones and clamped to -10 to 10V

notes: nothing runs until a clock is patched and the play switch is away from Off; every row's timing is counted in clock beats, so the module has no tempo of its own
each of the three rows has its own beats and steps count, so they come back into line only every so often; that is what makes long patterns out of short rows
each layer holds its own knobs, switches, ratios and gate pattern, and the panel shows only the current layer, so the controls jump when the layer changes
the semitone row is added to the note only while its step count is above none, and the same holds for the octave row
menu: Paste Mode — a label over the three choices below it, setting what a paste writes into the layer
Knobs + Beats — makes a paste write both the knob settings and the row ratios
Knobs Only — makes a paste write the knob settings and leave the row ratios alone
Beats Only — makes a paste write the row ratios and leave the knob settings alone
Copy Layer — takes a copy of the current layer
Paste Layer — writes the copied layer into the current one, as far as the paste mode allows
Paste to All Layers — writes the copied layer into all four, as far as the paste mode allows
Layer Advance by CV (1V/layer) — makes the layer jack pick the layer directly at one volt per layer, instead of each rise stepping to the next

inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 1 to 24V.

outputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
